Sub: Q1 - FY 2027 - Earnings Conference Call Audio Recording 
This is further to our letter dated July 27, 2026 intimating the details of Earnings conference 
call on the unaudited financial results for Q1 FY 2026-27 held today July 30, 2026.   
 
In this regard, we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the aforesaid call held today
